notes.title: Fear Odyssey Demo Update 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]In this update:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Death animation
[*] New dialogues
[*] Menu improvements
[*] Improvement in collisions
[*] Improved enemy mechanics
[*] Adjusted sound volume

The final version with full content will be available soon, with a total of 8 levels, improvements to the demo levels, and 20 achievements!
